text: {"lessons":["I should not let small monthly fluctuations prompt unnecessary trades; patience has served me so far.","Selling Stock B at a gain felt satisfying, but I should base future sell decisions on my investment plan and portfolio risk—not just the pleasure of locking in a profit.","Because losses weigh on me more than gains please me, I should guard against holding losing positions merely to avoid realizing a loss, just as I should avoid selling winners too quickly."]}
